by
  -- Show A ∩ (B ∪ C) ⊆ (A ∩ B) ∪ (A ∩ C)
  intro x
  assume h: x ∈ A ∩ (B ∪ C)
  have h1: x ∈ A := Set.mem_inter.mp h
  have h2: x ∈ B ∪ C := Set.mem_inter.mp h
  cases h2 with h3 h4
  { exact Set.mem_union_left _ h3 }
  { exact Set.mem_union_right _ h4 }
  -- Show (A ∩ B) ∪ (A ∩ C) ⊆ A ∩ (B ∪ C)
  intro x
  assume h: x ∈ (A ∩ B) ∪ (A ∩ C)
  cases h with h1 h2
  { have h3: x ∈ A ∩ B := h1
    have h4: x ∈ A := Set.mem_inter.mp h3
    have h5: x ∈ B := Set.mem_inter.mp h3
    have h6: x ∈ B ∪ C := Set.mem_union_left _ h5
    exact Set.mem_inter.mk h4 h6 }
  { have h3: x ∈ A ∩ C := h2
    have h4: x ∈ A := Set.mem_inter.mp h3
    have h5: x ∈ C := Set.mem_inter.mp h3
    have h6: x ∈ B ∪ C := Set.mem_union_right _ h5
    exact Set.mem_inter.mk h4 h6 }
  -- Conclude equality
  exact Set.ext h1 h2
